sourceFields.SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: One grab sample was collected from each station using a Young-modified Van Veen grab sampler. The grab sampler nominally sampled an area of 440 cm2 and had a maximum depth of penetration of 10 cm. The sediments were live-sieved in the field with a 0.5 mm mesh screen. Organisms retained on the screen were placed in plastic containers and fixed in 10% buffered formalin with rose bengal stain for preservation.
sourceFields.SamplePreparationMethod/MethodDescriptio:
Collected sediments were live-sieved in field w/0.5 mm mesh screen. Organisms retained on screen were placed in plastic jars. Rinse outside of sample jar into sieve; use funnel to rinse contents into jar and fill to 700 ml mark w/seawater. Use second jar if necessary.  Fix sample w/10% buffered formalin with rose bengal stain for preservation.
Fill jar to rim w/seawater to eliminate air space. Store in dark until shipped.
sourceFields.SampleTransportStorageDescription: Store the preserved sample upright in the dark until transport/shipment to the laboratory.
